extracted.intended_audience: readers, editors, and compilers of magazine short fiction; literary scholars and librarians interested in notable short stories from 1918
extracted.subtask_description: A compiled Roll of Honor listing notable short stories (foreign and American authors) published in American magazines January–October 1918, with notational conventions marking special excellence and previous inclusions. Used as a bibliographic/curatorial record rather than a how-to guide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indicator of special excellence (asterisk)
rubrics_metrics.description: Note. Stories of special excellence are indicated by an asterisk.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An asterisk next to a story title denotes that the compilers judged that story to be of special excellence. This is a selection marker used in the Roll of Honor to single out exceptional pieces.

rubrics_metrics.name: Index-figure notation for prior inclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: The index figures i, 2, 3, and 4 prefixed to the name of the author indicate that his work has been included in the Rolls of Honor for 1914, 1915, 1916, and 1917 respectively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric prefixes (1, 2, 3, 4) denote that the author had work previously featured in the Roll(s) of Honor for the listed prior years; this signals repeat recognition or sustained excellence across years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusion of reprints
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only original magazine publications within the January–October 1918 window were considered; reprinted material was not eligible for inclusion on this Roll of Honor.
